admission.justification: Error cutting inside the measured bound is proved by the named passing final-measure case; single-file member of the family.

applicability: Every short form carrying an error.
conditions: Character count and token count are distinct.
errorCut marks cut error text and is part of the measured form.
The original error remains subject to the existing successful-detail-recording, redaction and budget contract; this change creates no new retention waiver.
exclusions: Exact recorded location and final hint can exhaust the target before any error text remains.
statement: Errors in short forms are cut to 600 characters and then end-reduced against the measured 400-token target with errorCut; the error field is retained. The exact recorded-result location and final cut hint take precedence when the recorded path and its hint cannot fit after other droppable content is removed. Whole-result retention remains under the existing detail-recording contract.
